project: Turn Red Gaps Green — FLUME Validation + Technical Debt
description: The 2026-02-23 investigation identified six critical red flags ("Red Gaps") in FLUME VAE that block confidence in the system's correctness: KL collapse risk, unknown reconstruction fidelity, unknown synthetic trajectory quality, unvalidated evaluation metrics, unknown agent integration impact, and unvalidated memory/persistence tooling. Alongside these, lint technical debt (RUF012/RUF006), broken SurrealDB integration tests, and a missing persistent memory MCP layer need resolution. This PRD drives TDD-first resolution of every red gap: write a failing test that proves the gap exists, implement the fix, verify the test turns green.

userStories.title: CLI Training Entry Point
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a CLI script that orchestrates FLUME data generation, training, evaluation, and checkpoint saving so I can run the full pipeline in one command.
acceptanceCriteria: `scripts/train_flume.py` runs end-to-end with `--n-samples 50 --epochs 2 --evaluate`
Flags work: `--epochs`, `--batch-size`, `--lr`, `--n-samples`, `--evaluate`, `--checkpoint-dir`, `--require-ollama`, `--save-data`, `--load-data`, `--load-checkpoint`
`--epochs 0` skips training, allows data generation or eval-only mode
Exit code 0 on success, 1 on failure
`tests/flume/test_cli_train.py` passes — covers argument parsing and mocked pipeline integration
All 158 existing FLUME tests still pass

userStories.title: Bootstrap Training Data Generation
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to generate ~5,000 real Ollama-embedded training samples so the VAE trains on semantic vectors, not synthetic noise.
acceptanceCriteria: `data/flume/training/bootstrap.npz` created with shape `(5000, 768)` embeddings
Embeddings are 768D (not 256D hash fallback — verified via shape check)
Contrastive pairs array present with all indices in valid range
`data/flume/training/` is in `.gitignore`
Verification: `python3 -c "import numpy as np; d=np.load(...); assert d['embeddings'].shape == (5000, 768)"` passes

userStories.title: Train VAE and Validate Convergence (Red Gap 1 — KL Collapse)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to train FlumeVAE for 50 epochs and confirm KL loss does not collapse to zero, so I know the VAE is learning a probabilistic latent space.
acceptanceCriteria: Training completes 50 epochs without errors
Final epoch loss < epoch 5 loss (loss decreasing after warmup)
KL loss > 0.1 after warmup completes (beta reaches max)
Checkpoint saved at `data/flume/checkpoints/flume_vae_latest.pt` in v2 format (input_dim=768, latent_dim=256)
`FlumeVAEEncoder` can load the v2 checkpoint (v2 detection path exercised)
Red Gap 1 (KL collapse) resolved with evidence: printed KL value in training log

userStories.title: Run Evaluation Suite Against Green-Light Criteria (Red Gaps 2, 3, 4)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to run the full evaluation suite against the 5 green-light criteria to know whether FLUME's reconstruction, semantic ranking, and evaluation metrics are valid.
acceptanceCriteria: Evaluation runs on trained checkpoint without errors
All 5 metrics computed and printed with PASS/FAIL: KL > 0.1, active units ≥ 128, cos_sim > 0.95, P@1 > 0.85, Spearman rho > 0.90
Results saved to `data/flume/checkpoints/evaluation_results.json`
All 5 criteria pass — if < 5 pass, auto-iterate: adjust hyperparameters (more epochs, different β schedule, KL annealing) and retrain until all 5 green-light criteria are met
RED GAPS 2 (reconstruction fidelity), 3 (synthetic quality), 4 (eval metrics) each have a measured value with evidence of passing threshold

userStories.title: SemanticCache A/B Comparison (Red Gap 5)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a benchmark proving FLUME VAE embeddings outperform hash-based embeddings on paraphrase retrieval, so I know FLUME integration helps the agent.
acceptanceCriteria: `scripts/benchmark_semantic_cache.py` runs end-to-end with `--checkpoint data/flume/checkpoints/flume_vae_latest.pt`
Benchmark uses 100 task descriptions from SyntheticTaskGenerator
Metrics printed: Precision, Recall, F1 for both FLUME and hash baseline
FLUME F1 > hash F1 (FLUME wins)
`tests/flume/test_cache_ablation.py` passes — validates benchmark logic with known inputs
Red Gap 5 (integration impact) resolved: concrete F1 comparison in output

`FlumeVAEEncoder.DEFAULT_MODEL_PATH` updated to `flume_vae_latest.pt`
MISSION_JOURNAL updated with training results summary

userStories.title: Fix RUF006 — Asyncio Dangling Tasks
userStories.description: As a developer, I need all fire-and-forget `asyncio.create_task()` calls to store references so tasks aren't garbage-collected mid-execution.
acceptanceCriteria: `tests/lint/test_ruf006_dangling_tasks.py` written FIRST and fails
Standard fix applied: `self._background_tasks: set[asyncio.Task] = set()` in `__init__`, task stored and discarded on completion
Special case: `connection_pool.py` `_initialize_pool` converted to async (called lazily, not from `__init__`)
Special case: `base.py` subclass safety — `_background_tasks = getattr(self, '_background_tasks', set())` fallback
`uv run ruff check src/cohezion/ --select RUF006` reports 0 errors
All existing tests still pass

userStories.title: Fix SurrealDB 3.0 Compatibility and Integration Tests
userStories.description: As a developer, I need SurrealDB integration tests to pass against the running SurrealDB 3.0.0 server. The installed Python SDK (surrealdb 1.0.8) targets ≤2.x and may not speak the 3.0 protocol correctly — a minimal custom client layer may be required to bridge the gap.
acceptanceCriteria: Probe SDK 1.0.8 against SurrealDB 3.0.0 server: document which operations succeed and which fail

If SDK is incompatible: implement `src/cohezion/core/persistence/surreal_v3_client.py` — a minimal WebSocket client that speaks the SurrealDB 3.0 RPC protocol (JSON-RPC over WS), wrapping only the operations the test suite needs (connect, signin, use, query, create, select, update, delete)
`_normalize_query_for_v3()` logic in `surreal_client.py` validated against 3.0 syntax (COMPUTED fields, HNSW indexes, SCHEMAFULL strictness)
`tests/integration/test_surreal_persistence.py` event loop isolation fixed — `scope="function"` fixtures replace `scope="module"` where causing mismatches
`asyncio` primitives moved to `__init__` (not class-level) where needed
All 6 previously failing tests now pass, 23 errors resolved
No regressions in other integration tests
`pyproject.toml` dependency updated to reflect actual compatibility (pin or replace surrealdb SDK if custom client is used)
